title: Frontend: CourseForm shared component — create + edit mode
content:
Build a reusable CourseForm component that handles both create and edit modes.

Props: mode ('create' | 'edit'), initialData (Course | null), onSuccess callback, dict.

Fields (core course fields only — schedule/syllabus/instructor management deferred):
- nameZh, nameEn, nameCn (text inputs)
- slug (text input, auto-generated from nameEn if empty)
- category (dropdown or text)
- iaRefNumber (text)
- cpdHours (number)
- price, unitPrice (currency/decimal)
- capacity (number)
- deliveryMode (text)
- language (text)
- descriptionZh, descriptionEn, descriptionCn (textarea)
- registrationStatus (dropdown: OPEN/CLOSED — FEW_SEATS/FULL set automatically by system)
- generalInstructorId (dropdown — fetch from GET /api/admin/instructors if endpoint exists, otherwise plain text field)
- organizerZh, organizerEn (text)
- feeDescriptionZh, feeDescriptionEn, feeDescriptionCn (textarea)

Validation: Zod schema matching POST/PATCH expectations, inline error display below each field.

States: idle (form visible), submitting (loading spinner on submit button), success (toast + redirect), error (toast with message).

i18n: All labels, placeholders, validation messages use dict (useAdminDict).

Submit: POST /api/admin/courses in create mode, PATCH /api/admin/courses/[id] in edit mode.
acceptance: Form renders all core course fields with labels from dict
Zod validation shows inline errors for invalid fields
Create mode submits POST and shows success toast
Edit mode pre-fills data and submits PATCH
Error state shows toast with server error message
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && render form in both modes, submit valid/invalid data
